title: Designating More Marine Spaces as Marine Parks and Protecting Marine Wildlife and Coastal Habitats
what_it_is: Designating More Marine Spaces as Marine Parks and Protecting Marine Wildlife and Coastal Habitats

sections.label: Sisters' Islands Marine Park established
sections.summary: In 2014, the Sisters' Islands Marine Park was established, including western reefs of St John's Island and Pulau Tekukor, to promote conservation, research, outreach and recreation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: In 2014, we established the Sisters’ Islands Marine Park, which includes the western reefs of St John’s Island and Pulau Tekukor, to promote conservation, research, outreach and sustainable nature-based recreation in this area.

sections.label: NParks marine research and protection
sections.summary: NParks will continue to research the ecological status and functions of marine areas and study how best to protect them, including considering additional marine parks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: NParks will continue to research the ecological status and functions of our marine areas and study how best to protect them, including considering additional marine parks.

sections.label: Southern Islands Biodiversity Survey
sections.summary: In January 2020, NParks initiated a Southern Islands Biodiversity Survey with partners, expected to be completed by the end of 2023.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: In January 2020, just a couple of years ago, just before COVID-19, NParks initiated a Southern Islands Biodiversity Survey in partnership with the academic community, nature interest groups and citizen scientists.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: NParks expects the survey to be completed by the end of 2023.

sections.label: Inter-governmental platforms for marine efforts
sections.summary: The answer is yes; the Friends of Marine Park and the Integrated Urban Coastal Management framework initiated in 2009 are existing platforms.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: On the first point about whether there are inter-governmental groups or existing platforms to bring some of these efforts together, even as we think about looking at the survey results, the answer is yes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: I talked about the Friends of Marine Park in my earlier reply to Mr Louis Ng's question, but I would also like to bring the Member's attention to what we are doing under the Integrated Urban Coastal Management framework which we initiated in 2009.

sections.label: Science-based marine conservation approach
sections.summary: NParks adopts a science-based approach guided by the Nature Conservation Masterplan, with strict pollution laws and a whole-of-Government approach under the Integrated Urban Coastal Management framework.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: NParks adopts a science-based approach to strengthen the conservation of our native marine biodiversity and these efforts are already guided by our Nature Conservation Masterplan which we released earlier.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: To complement this, we have strict laws governing the management of both land- and sea-based sources of pollution, which answers Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin's question.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Furthermore, under the Integrated Urban Coastal Management framework, we take a whole-of-Government approach to ensure that our marine environments are protected, even within one of the world's busiest port areas.
